quotes.text: Don't worry, I'm on the case.
No one's stopping me.
If they're smart, they'll stay out of my way.
They don't know who they're dealing with.
No one's killing me.
Try and stop me. See what happens.
My father doesn't have high expectations for me; he has appropriate expectations for me. After all, when you're the best, why shouldn't you expect success?
Mark my words: I will represent Ixia in the Olympics. It's only a matter of time.
My ambitions are far higher than Blackmore Academy.
I will honor my family's name.
The Patrons are lucky to have someone like me fight for them.
I'm ready to test myself.
There ain't no city like New York.
Oh, I suppose I can't sit in Central Park forever...
I can't let my chess-playin' friend have all the fun.
My place is rent-controlled, I'm not lettin' anything happen to it.
I'm tired of people talking about urban decay being inevitable. You know what would stop urban decay? People giving a shit.
You know who would stay home during the ritual? Mildred. Mm hm, and I'm no Mildred.
My creator needs my help, and I won't let her down.
I'll do whatever it takes to save Miss Shelly.
Miss Shelly's a good person, and probably wouldn't condone me participating in bloodsport for money. I, however, am not shackled by human morality, and find it a rather entertaining use of my time.
Miss Shelly is taking her nap. I probably got enough time to contact some godlike creature!
People get me all wrong. I'm not interested in violence for violence's sake! I'm interested in violence for money's sake.
A little trouble never hurt anyone!
What’re we standing around for? Let’s start breaking shit!

If you think the OSIC are the good guys, bro? You gotta wake up and take a look around. Regulation is just a three-dollar-word for hoarding, which is just a two-dollar-word for controlling, which is just a one-dollar-word for asshole!
The hell are you starin’ at, buddy?
People ask me if I’m angry all the time. And it’s like “yeah, I’m pissed, why aren’t you?”
Hey, your taste in music? Sucks.
Bebop belongs in a scrap pile, and Lash was relevant for like twenty minutes three years ago. I’ll kick both their asses!
It's important to surround yourself with disposable- I mean, good people.
It was smart to ask for my help.
Greatness is a prison.
I always get what I want. You'll see.
Let's get this show on the road, shall we?
What better way to show off my product than to kill a god?
I like workin' the sideshow. They're, uh... they're my people, y'know?
You are about to see something rare and wonderful!
It's time to show people who I really am.
The secret was gonna get out sooner or later.
Even in a world where magic surrounds us, skeptics abound.
Folks can hear the Jersey Devil perform in a comedy club and go along with it, but I tell 'em that I'm a unicorn, and everyone acts like I'm the biggest carny in the world!
My friend, you look like you're in need of a skeleton with a jetpack. And not just any jetpack, the Fairfax Industries Chimera Mark 1.
At Fairfax Industries, we say "All's Fair", but that's not true, because with the Fairfax Chimera Mark 1, you have the advantage.
Some people look at me and say that I am a salesman, but that is not true. A salesman's job is to sell products; I am a prophet. A man blessed and cursed with the duty of showing you the future.
Today, Zephyrs make airship flight possible- but what if there was a better way?
Ladies and gentlemen, the demonstration that you are about to see is extremely dangerous.

Fairfax industries has always been the vanguard of occult technology, but today, visionary Maximilian Fairfax, and genius Margaret McGinnis have crafted the thing of military dreams. It is my honor, it is my privilege, and I daresay it is the highlight of my career to present to you: The Chimera Mark 1!
I never had much use for a name. Names are for people who want to be remembered. Me? [Chuckle] My existence is like gravity or time. A concept that you fear, but you cannot escape. I simply... am.
The Troubadour ain’t got nothin’ on me.
Oh, I’m exactly who you think I am.
By the time I’m through with them, the cops won’t be able to identify the body.
Fact of the matter is: I'd do this for free. The Patron's gift is just a bonus.
The elders of New Amsterdam are soft, clinging to archaic titles like they grant them real power.
Grading can wait.
Looks like I'll have to cancel class this afternoon!
Oh, I wouldn't miss this for the world!
One day, my body will be returned to me.
Let me collect my extremities and I'll be right there.
Well then, looks like we have work to do.
Graveyards aren’t quiet. They’re loud. Sometimes, it’s overwhelming. But if you stop and listen, the dead can tell one hell of a story.
Great! I’m running around Manhattan with a severed lich hand, how did this become my life?
The dead have been making a whole lot of demands lately.
This should make my mentor happy.
Completing some eldritch ritual beats finishing my paper of Wuthering Heights.
Of course I’ll help.
My bow is yours.
I'm coming for you, Hathorne.
I won't be lectured on morality.
Blood demands blood.
The hunt is on.
There is no escaping me.
They won't see me coming.
I will bring the end.
I'm here on OSIC business.
I dedicated my life to the OSIC. I won't fail them.
I am the bright light's dark shadow.
No more waiting. The time is now.
God, I hate this city.
I never got to meet my grandpa, but I know I'll make him proud.
You can only run from the law for so long.
When I find who I'm looking for, I'm not bringing him in. I'm putting him down.
I let my town down once, but I'm gonna make it right today.
Justice isn't always swift, but it comes for everyone.
What'll it be today?
Believe me, I've seen some things.
Sometimes, you gotta go to extremes to help your friends.
If I'm not dealing with one type of patron, I'm dealing with another!
They don't need a bouncer when I'm tending bar!
Don't you worry, I got you.
Don't worry, I'll protect you.
Looks like I'm missing that job interview...
Helping people's what I do.
I'll do anything to keep the people of Spanish Harlem safe.
If you need me, I got your back.
Maybe today won't be so boring after all.
Time for an adventure!
Let's get started, shall we?
I'm feeling good about this, yes?
The anticipation... oh, it's exciting, yes?
Look at us. A couple of miscreants, ready to take on the world!
It may be the single malt but, I'm feeling very optimistic.
Of course you picked me.
My debt to Oathkeeper will be paid.
Let's have fun, darling.
I will never be forgotten.
I paid a terrible price for a second chance. And I would gladly pay it again.
There's no turning back now.
When I come for you, you're gonna know it. There's just not a damn thing that you can do about it.
You were looking to summon a god, right? Well, here I am.
Ohh, I'll summon the Patrons. But just so I can tell 'em... "you're welcome".
Reason 26 I'm better than Bebop: Only one of us has an impossibly dashing mustache.
Reason number 87 I'm better than Bebop: He's Bebop.
See, not everyone can handle the weight of being the best fighter on God's green Earth.
Let's get to work.
This should be fun.
Do I love working for Fairfax Industries? No. Does it pay a small fortune? Yes. How do I sleep at night? Like a baby.
What's the point of building toys if you never get to use 'em?
Ready to do some field testing.
Nothing I can't build.
I hope I get to work with Lady Geist. She's an icon!
It was either do this or go to a lame vampire salon, and let me tell you, I do not plan on putting up with 6 hours of harpsichord music.
The elders can keep the old world. New York is going to be my playground.
God, I look good today.
I'm tired of being at the bottom of the vampiric social ladder.
Time to shake up the vampiric hierarchy.
You're under my protection now.
My vows are not taken lightly.
Building a nation never comes easy.
I will play my part, and in doing so build a home for the Djinn.
I fight on behalf of the Djinn.
New York seems like a lovely place.
It's not the rats in New York they should worry about.
He does the digging, I do the talking. We tried it the other way but, it didn't work.
There's nothing Maurice can't claw through.
Don't mind Maurice, he's not chatty around new people.
I got the gun, he's got the claws.
Don't mind the big guy, he's friendly. Unless, of course, you tried to stop us, in which case he would definitely maul you.
I’m excited! Okay, that’s a lie, I’m really nervous…
This is gonna make for one hell of a story…
I just hope I’m not too late to save him…
One of the things I love the most about Arthurian legend is that you have these noble heroes that are totally morally compre- Oh my god, I didn’t notice the time, we have to complete the ritual!

Do you think I brought enough books? I mean, it’s probably enough, but I remember this one time I planned on it being an Austen day, but life was like: “sorry lady, it’s Brontë time,” and I was just, god, I was not prepared.
Who am I to resist a perfectly good prophecy?
In time, all men die, the gun just speeds things up.
Trust me: You want me on your side.
People who say you can't outrun a bullet have a severe lack of imagination.
Time travel isn't a thing... yet.
Time's a-wastin'! That was a little time joke. Not sure if you picked up on that.
Do- really? Don't expect me to explain how this all works. Just be happy that it works.
No more hiding.
I'll do whatever it takes to keep this case from my father.
I'll use my family's name when I'm no longer ashamed of it.
My father's gift for my 18th birthday was a bullet to the chest. Today is my chance to say "thank you".
We can build a better world.
I don't like to talk about my past. But I'm ready to move forward.
I've waited long enough! It's time to bring my enemies to their knees.
Look: These guys are idiots, but they're my idiots. And I'm gonna give 'em the home they deserve.
Long Island is gonna be mine.
All those humans with their "mattresses" and their "blankets without holes" and their "refrigerators"...
They think they're better than us... but they're not. They're nothin'! They're dirt! And pretty soon? They're gonna be dead.
None of these idiots know what it's like to be responsible for millions of lives, but I do. And all I gotta do to make it better for my people is eradicate some of theirs.
Being awake is hard!
New York is so big!
There are so many places I couldn't nap!
I need to find home.
I'll help us!
Help me get home!
So you've called on me.
My help comes with a price.
I have no equal.
I'm no one's pawn.
My reputation speaks for itself.
With these hands I will destroy, and with these hands I will rebuild.
Leave this to a professional.
Time to kill some monsters.
The Baxter Society sent me.
This shouldn't take long.
There's a lot of scary things out there, kid. I'm just scarier.
The Baxter Society saved my life, and now I'm gonna save yours.
Look, I gotta kill time to avoid Midtown traffic so it's either summon an elder god or do my laundry, and I don't have it in me to fold shit.
The Patron made me a promise. And I intend to collect.
Doing this for money and... well... just money.
There have got to be easier ways to get my life together...
Why does this have to be the one thing I'm good at? Why couldn't I have stuck with piano?
The crazies are gonna be out in full force tonight, let me tell you.
I can't wait to be done with you.
Yeah, the feeling's mutual, buddy.
The Magnificent Henry is ready to help.
Yeah, you calling yourself "magnificent" is hilarious.
Allow us to be of service!
Us? I'll be doing 90% of the work!
I was hoping that I could sit back and enjoy my day, but it looks like the Patrons are gonna need some adult supervision.
Too many people would abuse the Patron's gift. I can't let that power fall into the wrong hands.
Those with real strength don't need to show it.
I don't take this decision lightly.
I'm ready to do what needs to be done.
Winning always comes with sacrifice... and I'm ready to make mine.
I am at your service.
I am honored to serve at your pleasure.
I think you’ll find the service at The Baroness to be… exemplary.
I find perception and reality intersect far less than most would think.
May your time in New York be unforgettable.
After the ritual is complete, if you’d like tickets to South Pacific, don’t be afraid to ask.
The Lord is merciful... I am not.
I don't get to walk the Righteous path. I blaze the trail so that others may do so safely.
Evil stirs in New York... and so the Vatican has called on me.
I am the Sword of Saint Benedict!
We all have a callin'--the only question is, do we have the courage to answer it?
Today the hunter prays for your blessing, and absolution.
I'm going to find out where I came from.
The Patron will have answers. I know it.
The pain doesn't get any better. I just get better at hiding it.
Forget figuring out my purpose in life, I just wanna know who my left arm belongs to.
Who the hell stitches together dead bodies? At least I hope they were dead bodies. Oh god, what if they weren't dead bodies?
When I think about who made me, I picture some awkward scientist wishing for a son. Knowing my luck, I'm probably a serial killer's walking trophy collection.
Hathorne's disciples will answer for their crimes.
Justice is a fantasy for those who lack the conviction of revenge.
Today isn't the day for mercy.
The Friends of Humanity will be eradicated from this Earth.
I've been given my chance for revenge, and I won't squander it.
I was a child when they unjustly condemned me. Powerless in every sense of the word. But now, in death, I've become all that they feared and more.
I worked too hard to get here, I can't stop now.
I know I can do this, I just need the chance to prove it
Thank you, I can't wait to show you who I really am.
Too late to back out now, right?
I'd be crazy to pass this opportunity up.
I'm not going to pretend I'm not scared... but I'm not going to pretend I can't do this either.
Greetings from the Deep.
Today will be unforgettable!
Most of my kind find legs to be unnerving, but I rather enjoy them.
I was hoping that this suit would make people take the problems of the Deep seriously. I'm not sure it's working.
I am not a pile of goo. I'm merely piloting a pile of goo.
You don't know how easy you have it on the surface.
[Chuckles] How hard can summoning an elder god be?
Yeah, yeah, I'm a work-in-progress. Pick me.
Look, I'm not saying you need my help, I'm just saying, uh... No, I'm- I actually am saying you need my help.
Ah, sometimes I think "Man, it would be so fun to break out of Lost Whisper" and then I think "V, that is a dumbass idea".
I don't get why Wraith won't let me take out a marker, I paid it off! Once.
You ever get the feeling that something bad is gonna happen?... Yeah so, I don't, that's why I end up in jail so much.
The Patrons must be stopped. No matter the cost.
My family failed to protect this city once before. It cannot happen again.
I will make up for my parents' failures.
Too often people think of the benefits without ever considering the costs.
Humanity needs to be protected from itself.
The Patrons will herald the end of humanity if we let them.
If you think crime doesn't pay, you are outrageously bad at crime.
No one builds an empire without sacrifice.
Thank god for vices.
The great part about being a degenerate gambler is that you get really good at setting up your own action. Broke? Yeah. Bored? Never.
I don't appreciate the news labeling some of my services as "rackets". Who wouldn't love being protected by me?
You think I handle money? Please. That stuff is filthy.
I inherited this name from my brother.
I received this name for a reason. It must never be tarnished.
If I die, someone else will inherit this sword. Just as I did.
I'll cut down anyone in my way.
Follow me! I'll lead you to victory.
I'll build a mountain of corpses.
